rationale: Build on the current best late-aligned decoder-skip recurrent-tail baseline by combining the two closest valid misses in the same family: reverse replay order (+0.0002) and full QKV float rescue on the repeated tail blocks (+0.0003). This keeps the 9x512 quant-aware endgame intact, stays compile-stable, and spends extra bytes directly on the repeatedly used tail attention path instead of on new heads or another small hyperparameter sweep.
title: Reverse-Order Tail Recurrence With Tail QKV Float Rescue
